groom.name: Daniel
groom.parents: Son of Mr. & Mrs. Wong Wei Ming

wedding.tagline: Together with their families, Sarah & Daniel joyfully invite you to share in the celebration of their marriage.

quote.en: Where there is love, there is life.

story.title: First Encounter
story.description: We met at a mutual friend's coffee shop opening in Petaling Jaya. Daniel ordered the same drink as Sarah — a flat white — and the conversation never stopped.

story.title: Becoming Us
story.description: After years of late-night calls and weekend road trips, we knew this was it. We moved in together and adopted our cat, Mochi.

story.title: The Proposal
story.description: Daniel proposed at the rooftop of our favourite café in Penang, with family photos hidden in the decoration and a ring that had been in his family for generations.

story.title: The Big Day
story.description: We cannot wait to celebrate with all of you — the people who made us who we are.

gifts.message: Your presence is the greatest gift of all. For those who wish to bless us further, any contribution is deeply appreciated.
